workarounds.symptom: [PYSEC-2026-1872] Requests vulnerable to .netrc credentials leak via malicious URLs (Affects requests < 2.32.4)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade requests to patched release >= 2.32.4: pip install --upgrade 'requests>=2.32.4' (Advisory: PYSEC-2026-1872)

workarounds.symptom: [PYSEC-2026-1873] Requests `Session` object does not verify requests after making first request with verify=False (Affects requests < 2.32.0)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade requests to patched release >= 2.32.0: pip install --upgrade 'requests>=2.32.0' (Advisory: PYSEC-2026-1873)
